edges.context: Sidebar.svelte derives pageTree from currentPages using buildSidebarTree, so page navigation renders from hierarchical page data rather than flat page arrays.
Sidebar.svelte derives reusableBlocksTree from folders and reusableBlocks so content library navigation mirrors folder/block hierarchy.
An effect in Sidebar.svelte iterates collectAncestorPageIds(pageTree, activePageId) and clears closedNodes for each ancestor id.
Sidebar.svelte derives active reusable block folder id then reopens folder ancestors returned by collectReusableBlockFolderAncestors.
Sidebar.svelte watches desktopFocus, opens target folders when needed, then scrolls page/content sections into view.
runSidebarAction posts an intent payload, applies returned pages/blockFolders/reusableBlocks/reference maps, then shows a success or error notice.
Sidebar delete page modal sends intent deletePage, blocks child-page deletion in UI, and redirects away from deleted editor route.
Sidebar delete folder modal tells user folder deletion only succeeds when no child folders or content items exist.
Sidebar delete content modal lists pages referencing the block and warns references will be removed from published and draft pages.
insertBlockIntoCurrentPage calls requestReusableBlockInsert and reports success only when a page editor handler is registered.
Sidebar.svelte accepts reusableBlockPageReferences from sidebar action responses and stores them for delete content modals.
